Street Fighter and Suntory team up to fight thirst together


In a rather odd collaboration, Street Fighter developer Capcom has partnered with beverage giant Suntory as part of a “The Strong Fighter II” campaign. The highlight of this mashup is the augmented reality game which can be downloaded for smartphones through scanning a special QR code. You can then scan a bottle of Suntory’s THE STRONG sparkling spring water before engaging in an ice-breaking strength test using either Ryu or Chun Li.  The game boasts the original sprites and the characters’ signature moves, as well as of course the necessary button inputs.   Related Posts   Pokemon Sleep Now Available In Malaysia   GamerBraves Newsletter Vol. 103 – The Glory of The Barbie/Oppenheimer Double Feature   For context, the campaign serves to celebrate the 35th anniversary of the Street Fighter franchise. THE STRONG on the other hand is Suntory’s line of ‘extra carbonated’ sparkling water. We don’t exactly see the connection here but this appears to be a rather cool campaign either way anyway, and we get an awesome as heck promotional trailer to go with it.
If your interest has been piqued, be sure to check out The Strong Fighter AR game, which is now available to download for Android via Google Play and iOS via the App Store. Also head over the official website for more information and the QR code itself.

reference_summary: Capcom dan Suntory telah bekerjasama untuk kempen yang dipanggil "The Strong Fighter II" untuk meraikan ulang tahun ke-35 Street Fighter. Kempen ini menampilkan permainan realiti tambahan untuk telefon pintar, di mana pemain boleh mengimbas sebotol air berkilauan THE STRONG Suntory dan mengambil bahagian dalam ujian kekuatan menggunakan Ryu atau Chun Li. Permainan ini menampilkan sprite asal dan pergerakan tandatangan watak, dan tersedia untuk dimuat turun pada peranti Android dan iOS. THE STRONG ialah barisan air berkilau "berkarbonat tambahan" Suntory, dan tidak jelas bagaimana ia disambungkan kepada Street Fighter.
